description: The patch, digest and pinning updates Renovate merges wait for the pull request's checks (ci.yml). Minor and major updates change what is promised and are only opened. The repository allows no auto-merge of its own, which is why Renovate does the merging

packageRules.description: The netns testbed's base image is pulled by a tag that is pushed again whenever its Debian layer or Go patch is rebuilt, so a checkout does not say which image a run used. Pinning the digest makes the Dockerfile name one image and leaves Renovate to move it

The go directive in go.mod is the Go the checks run (setup-go reads it) and the golang image is the Go the netns tests run in. They are the same minor on purpose: a test passing on one Go says little about another. Grouping them puts both on one branch, so they cannot drift apart one pull request at a time

A new Go minor (the go directive and the golang image) waits for approval on the dashboard, since raising the go directive raises what every user of the module must build with; patches and digests flow as usual
